newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar market closed for Hindu festival.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar market closed for Hindu festival.

text.p: The Bombay sugar market was closed on Monday for Holi, the Hindu spring festival of colours. It will reopen on Tuesday.
On Friday ready sugar S-30 was quoted at 1,255/1,270 rupees per quintal while M-30 was quoted at 1,290/1,345 rupees per quintal.

Sugar mill delivery moved down to 1,170/1,180 rupees per quintal from 1,180/1,205 rupees per quintal following sluggish outstation buying and lower than expected purchases by the bulk consumers at the mill level.
